description: Look up an OEM part number and list every laptop model it is documented to fit, with the official source URL for each fit. Matching ignores case, dashes and spaces and follows retired/superseded numbers; if the number matches several parts once dashes are ignored it returns status "ambiguous" with candidates (ask the user which one is printed on the part). If no part matches, the call returns an error result saying the part was not found: that means LPF has no document for it, not that it is incompatible; try search_parts. A part with no documented models returns fits: [] with fit_status no_documented_fit. For the reverse lookup (model to parts) use get_model_parts. For Screen parts each fit includes panel_options (null, or an object when that model has more than one documented screen option). Each part has lpf_url (its LPF page) and buy_links; follow buy_links_hint. Each fit has confidence: oem_manual, retailer or unverified.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

part_number.description: Required. OEM part number, with or without dashes or spaces, e.g. "L18M3PF1" or "01AV489"

name: get_part_fits

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get models a part fits
